DataSource.query:
select 
concat('C-', AA.COD_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT) as COD_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT, 
AA.LAB_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT_FR,
AA.LAB_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT_EN,
concat('G-', AG.COD_ACCOUNT_GROUP) as COD_ACCOUNT_GROUP,
AG.LAB_ACCOUNT_GROUP_FR,
AG.LAB_ACCOUNT_GROUP_EN,
concat('N-', AN.COD_ACCOUNT_NATURE) as COD_ACCOUNT_NATURE,
AN.LAB_ACCOUNT_NATURE_FR,
AN.LAB_ACCOUNT_NATURE_EN,
concat('B-', BA.COD_BUCHER_ATTRIBUTE) as COD_BUCHER_ATTRIBUTE, 
BA.LAB_BUCHER_ATTRIBUTE_FR,
BA.LAB_BUCHER_ATTRIBUTE_EN,
concat('R-', AR.COD_ACCOUNT_REGROUPMENT) as COD_ACCOUNT_REGROUPMENT,
AR.LAB_ACCOUNT_REGROUPMENT_FR,
AR.LAB_ACCOUNT_REGROUPMENT_EN,
case 
when (aa.COD_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT_TYPE in ('G', 'SAP') and (aa.cod_accounting_account between '100000' and '599999' 
or aa.cod_accounting_account between '0010000000' and '0059999999' ) ) or 
(ar.COD_ACCOUNT_REGROUPMENT in ('-1', '-2')) then 'Balance Sheet' 
else 'Profit and Loss' end as bilanresultat
from 
COMMON.DIM_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT AA,
common.DIM_ACCOUNT_GROUP AG,
common.DIM_ACCOUNT_NATURE AN,
common.DIM_BUCHER_ATTRIBUTE BA,
common.DIM_ACCOUNT_REGROUPMENT AR
where AA.SEQ_ACCOUNT_GROUP = AG.SEQ_ACCOUNT_GROUP
and AN.SEQ_ACCOUNT_NATURE=AG.SEQ_ACCOUNT_NATURE
and AN.SEQ_BUCHER_ATTRIBUTE=BA.SEQ_BUCHER_ATTRIBUTE
and BA.SEQ_ACCOUNT_REGROUPMENT=AR.SEQ_ACCOUNT_REGROUPMENT
order by COD_ACCOUNT_REGROUPMENT, COD_BUCHER_ATTRIBUTE, COD_ACCOUNT_NATURE, COD_ACCOUNT_GROUP, COD_ACCOUNTING_ACCOUNT
